posts.name: Shay Boloor
posts.text:
HBM4 and HBM4E are expected to nearly triple their share of HBM demand to 48% in 2027 as $NVDA Rubin and next-gen AI chips require a ton more advanced memory.

What’s also wild is that HBM3E 8-Hi is expected to double its share to 17% suggesting ASICs are expanding the market and giving $MU and $SKHY more ways to grow across both premium and mature memory.
